business_summary: Japan PropTech Co.,Ltd. develops and sells real estate operations support services in Japan. It provides inter-agent property distribution services, including RearPro BB Management that manages information on managed properties and RearPro BB Brokerage, which allows users to view published property information. The company also offers brokerage operation support services, such as customer relationship management, web advertising management service, property data linkage, IT emphasis, real estate sales support system, property search engine API, rental sales support system, Kurasapo real estate search site, and electronic payment services, as well as WebManagerPro3, a real estate website production software. In addition, it provides administrative support services comprising contract signing, entry/exit management, rent payment management, owner remittance, and building repair management; consumer support services; and construction estimate system. The company was formerly known as Nihon Jyoho Create Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Japan PropTech Co.,Ltd. in September 2023. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Miyakonojo, Japan.
